run_Predictor_predict: run the Predictor to detect objects in an image using a built-in vocabulary like lvis or coco
run_Predictor_custom_vocabulary: run the Predictor with a custom comma-separated vocabulary to detect user-defined object classes
run_Predictor_setup: run the Predictor setup to initialize the Detic model with SwinB weights and built-in classifiers
run_get_clip_embeddings: run get_clip_embeddings to generate CLIP text embeddings for a list of vocabulary terms
review_Predictor_class: review the Predictor class that wraps Detic zero-shot object detection with visualization output
